description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release improves file pasting and reply presentation, adds new Claude Code and Codex capabilities, and brings support for larger workspace backgrounds.
New
- Claude Code offers a thinking-summary switch, letting you show summaries of its reasoning from the agent’s settings.
- Codex offers follow-up prompt suggestions in chat, while automated runs skip generating suggestions to avoid extra model requests.
- GPT-6.1 Terra joins Codex’s built-in model list, with matching context-usage tracking.
Improved
- Pasting files and folders into desktop chat is more reliable, including files copied from your file manager and pasted through the right-click menu.
- Claude Code skills are easier to identify in / menus, with skill icons in chat, automation and task editors, plus source paths on hover when available.
- Instructions sent while Codex is working can guide the current task directly, while messages sent during an approval request stay queued.
- Workspace backgrounds support images up to 64 MiB and 100 million pixels, with more time allowed for large transfers and wallpaper downloads.
- Opening text flows naturally into later execution steps, with smoother transitions from waiting to the first reply content.
- Updated Claude Code to claude-agent-acp 0.99.1 and Codex to codex-acp 2.5.0.
- Antigravity 1.4.4 can read text files up to 16 MiB, avoiding failures when viewing files larger than 2 MiB.
- ZCode 0.79.1 improves request retries and failure messages, allowing you to resend in the same conversation when retries are exhausted.
Fixed
- Claude Code receives pasted PDFs correctly and preserves their attachment display in history, without duplicating messages sent with only an attachment.
- Claude Code can fork conversations across working directories and offers a sign-in action when your login expires.
- Codex history preserves clickable file references and gives clearer explanations for ChatGPT workspace connection failures.
- Codex handles Google Cloud Vertex AI configuration correctly, avoiding incompatible settings when binding a provider or changing WebSocket options.
- Command Code 1.88.2 fixes a startup failure affecting fresh installations.
- Qoder 1.1.81 stops pending tool calls correctly when you cancel during approval, and history retains the model name when later records leave it blank.
Note
- Qoder’s follow-up reply after a background sub-agent finishes currently appears after reopening the conversation, rather than arriving live.
